messages:
Maria G: Hi folks — quick onboarding question :wave: I converted from contractor to full-time on 2024-02-05 and I'm trying to sort a few items:
1) When do benefits (medical/dental) actually become active after a conversion?  
2) How is PTO/holiday accrual pro-rated for that partial month?  
3) My company expense card still shows 'not activated' in the portal. Who should I ping for each? Thanks!

Alex (People Ops): Congrats Maria! For benefits — please submit enrollment in the benefits portal. Effective date is usually the first day of the month after HR confirms FT status. If you enroll before the payroll cutoff we can usually get a 3/1 effective date; otherwise it'll be the following month. Exceptions for backdating are possible but limited.

Samir K: PTO accrual switches on your FT start date. Accrual is pro-rated by calendar month for a partial month — you'll see a reduced accrual for Feb since you started 2/05. Holidays that fall before your FT conversion are not retroactively granted, but we'll reconcile any differences if needed. If you want exact numbers I can pull your accrual table.

Maria G: Where do I view that accrual table myself?

Samir K: Payroll -> My Time -> Accruals should show it. If you don't see it, please email payroll@redwood.com and cc me and I'll escalate.

Benefits Team: @Maria G — please submit here: https://benefits.redwood.com/enroll and use plan code `RDW-STD-2024`. If you need dependent coverage backdated, upload proof (marriage cert / birth cert) in the document uploader and add a short note explaining the FT conversion date.

Maria G: Quick follow-up — I had a medical visit on 2024-02-10 (before the 3/1 effective date). Can that be reimbursed if I enroll now? :thinking:

Benefits Team: For claims before the effective date we can only reimburse if HR approves a backdated enrollment. Send the claim and supporting docs to benefits@redwood.com with your employee ID. We'll review for possible retroactive coverage; it's case-by-case.

Payroll Bot: Reminder: payroll/benefits cutoff is 02/20 for a 03/01 effective date. Status changes after cut-off move to the next cycle.

Maria G: Understood — thanks. About the card: my Wallet shows 'not activated' and the app rejected my last4 when I tried to activate.

Card Support: Hi Maria — sorry about that. Can you try re-activating via Wallet -> Company Card -> Activate? If you get an error paste the exact message here. We can issue a virtual card meantime.

Maria G: Re-sent activation — it now shows "Activation pending". Error: `last4 mismatch`.

Card Support: Thanks — I've pushed a sync to the card provider and triggered a new activation token. You should receive a one-time code by email in ~10 min. If that doesn't arrive we'll issue a virtual card and overnight a replacement physical card. :thumbsup:

Alex (People Ops): I'll follow up with Benefits about the backdating once Maria submits docs. @Samir K can you confirm the PTO numbers so Maria can plan vacation days?

Samir K: On it — I'll DM you the accrual table and post the summary here when ready.

Maria G: Amazing, thanks everyone — will submit the enrollment and docs today. Appreciate the quick help! :)
